Title: How to know which MediaSource caused ExoPlaybackException (on preloading the next track)?
Description: To handle `ExoPlaybackException` we must implement `EventListener.onPlayerError()`. If for example, we encounter a 403 HTTP error because the track's URL is expired,  we can catch it inside this function and take appropriate actions:
- See which track caused 403 exception.
- Check our application API to see if we have access to a new URL for the track.
- Replace the corresponding MediaSource with a new one having a valid & fresh URL.
- Play the new MediaSource.

It isn't clear how we can find which track caused the exception. Currently we are using `player.getCurrentWindowIndex()`. There is a new `mediaPeriodId` in the exception too, but I am not sure how to trace it back to `MediaSource`. Also I am not sure if either of `player.getCurrentWindowIndex()` or ` mediaPeriodId` leads me to the correct `MediaSource`, in case the media source was just preloaded and it is not actually the current playing media source.
